findings.assessment: The baseline entry calls vehicle_atmoe_head_configuration.configuration with the selected head count; the official runner persists that cfg.dump() and the mutated atmoe_heads argument. The bank requires demo/RGBNT100/seed42/atmoe_heads32, reconstructs through that same helper, and asserts cfg.dump()==trained[config] before constructing a model. The bank imports run_experiment.build. For the asserted demo variant it dispatches directly to make_model(cfg,classes,cameras), not an expert wrapper that reconstructs another config. DeMo stores cfg.MODEL.HEAD and forwards it to GeneralFusion/MoM. With the RGBNT100 ViT-B-16 config, feature width is512, ATMoE has32 partitions of16 channels and7 experts per partition, while the seven HDM readers retain8 attention heads. findings.assessment: source_records reads the official RGBNT100 bounding_box_train list with relabel=False and sorts records. full_records relabels only the training identities in sorted raw-ID order, retains every training record, enforces unique training names, and records raw IDs plus their contiguous label map. Query/gallery identities are disjoint from train by official_records. The bank requires8675 train/1715 query/8575 gallery/50 classes, exact equality to the selected teacher manifest, disjoint train/test names, and all50 contiguous labels. Query/gallery metadata is read for protocol validation but is not used to build centers or neighbor rankings. The bounded fixture checked8675 synthetic train records; installed data was not opened.

findings.assessment: The candidate has exactly one extract call, with train. extract is no_grad, uses make_loader(training=False), normalizes every descriptor and preserves loader order. That loader has no identity sampler, shuffle=False and drop_last=False, so8675 records form136 batches with35 records in the last batch. The model is in eval mode with gradients disabled; hook totals, feature shape and finiteness are asserted. No optimizer, backward, update, or weight-save call is made by the bank. These are source guarantees and retained runtime assertions, not completed neural measurements.

findings.topic: Correct centers and complete stable neighbor lists
findings.assessment: The bank averages the normalized record features separately for each contiguous training label, then L2-normalizes each center. It computes2-2*center_dot_product, places infinity on the diagonal, and uses stable ascending argsort to select49 identities. Every row is checked to contain exactly the other49 labels. The label/center/distance/neighbor statements are AST-identical to the old complete bank builder. A50-label scalar tie fixture preserves ascending label order; actual Torch/NumPy numerics were not run.

findings.assessment: The actual original consumer pins runs/r201ab_RGB_training_neighbors_20261012/result.json and requires SHA(anchor_run_dir/best.pth)==BANK[teacher_sha256]. It also validates complete neighbor rows and maps each raw manifest identity through BANK[training_labels] before comparing all record names/labels/cameras/scenes. Therefore its old bank cannot silently be used with a different HEAD32 teacher. The new bank preserves that schema, but this bank-only source does not redirect the existing consumer; later expert work is explicitly unimplemented/unadmitted. rewrite_epoch still preserves the epoch record multiset/P8K8 and deterministically swaps at most one future group per batch. Isolated existing teacher-assert fixtures accept a matching synthetic teacher and reject a different one; four bounded schedule fixtures preserve duplicates, ordering contracts and Python RNG.
